name: Mobile (360px) Unintended Page Horizontal Overflow
details: document.documentElement.scrollWidth equals window.innerWidth (360px); zero horizontal page scrolling.

name: Intentional Scroll Region Labelled and Accessible
details: The data table container is the only scrollable demonstration, properly labelled and keyboard scrollable.

name: Mobile Content Order (Article before Secondary)
details: Main content stacks vertically with article above related links (secondary).

name: Mobile Controls (#name, #comment) Usable & Unclipped
details: #name and #comment fit comfortably within the 360px viewport without clipping or compression.

name: Accessible Labels Associated with #name and #comment
details: Labels are explicitly linked via for="name" and for="comment" attributes.

name: Comment Form Event Effects & DOM Update
details: Form submission properly appends new comment to .comment-container and resets input fields.

name: Desktop (1280px) No Unintended Horizontal Overflow
details: Desktop layout renders cleanly with zero horizontal overflow.

name: Desktop Column Layout (Side-by-side)
details: Article (flex: 5) and secondary (flex: 2) maintain a two-column desktop layout.

name: Desktop Controls (#name, #comment) Within Viewport
details: Controls are positioned within normal flow and fully accessible.

name: Zero Page Errors Rejection
details: Zero unexpected console/page errors occurred during all tests.
